==About Voicelines==
{{VO
|character                   = Jianxin
|language                    = en

<!-- Thoughts -->
|vo_01_01_title              = Thoughts: I
|vo_01_01_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg
|vo_01_01_tx                 = You're a seasoned fighter, I can tell. Let's have a bout sometime soon, shall we? Sparring is my passion, and I can't pass up an opportunity to fight someone like you!

|vo_01_02_title              = Thoughts: II
|vo_01_02_intimacy           = 1
|vo_01_02_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg
|vo_01_02_tx                 = Erm, actually... I wonder just how you seem to know so much. I've been to the cities a few times, but I know very little compared to you. Can I ask you for help next time I run into things I don't understand? Please bear with me, though, as it may take me some time to catch on...

|vo_01_03_title              = Thoughts: III
|vo_01_03_intimacy           = 2
|vo_01_03_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg
|vo_01_03_tx                 = I grew up in my sect, on a remote, secluded mountain. Most people may find it a bit challenging to make it there, but it should be easy for you. I can take you there if you want. Hehe, honestly, I've always wanted to bring you home as my guest!

|vo_01_04_title              = Thoughts: IV
|vo_01_04_intimacy           = 3
|vo_01_04_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg
|vo_01_04_tx                 = I wasn't the brightest kid, but I was lucky to find my talent in martial arts. That's why I really admire people with both brains and courage. Of all the smart people I know, you're the best, being a great martial artist and a true defender of justice. You are the one I look up to the most, beside my masters.

|vo_01_05_title              = Thoughts: V
|vo_01_05_intimacy           = 4
|vo_01_05_file               = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg
|vo_01_05_tx                 = I adore being part of nature's harmony. Every songbird in the sky, every leaf on the ground, and every glimmer of sunlight makes me feel a serene joy, as the sweet breezes surround me, whispering life's many blessings. Your presence brings me the same kind of feeling, Rover. With you, everything feels so right, like I belong where I should.


<!-- Miscellaneous -->
|vo_02_01_title              = Jianxin's Hobby
|vo_02_01_file               = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg
|vo_02_01_tx                 = My life's goal is to one day fully master Fengyiquan. For me, every place—be it in the valley, on a mountain peak, or a bustling market—provides an opportunity to perfect my art. I find joy in connecting with various energies and Chi available across different places; this connection gives me new chances of growth.

|vo_02_02_title              = Jianxin's Trouble
|vo_02_02_file               = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg
|vo_02_02_tx                 = Worthy opponents are always hard to find. I always yearn for a good fight from which I can learn and improve myself. That said, I'm not too invested in looking for challenges anymore. One can only find inner peace when they let go of their desires. I can find my growth without engaging in frequent battles.

|vo_02_03_title              = Favorite Food
|vo_02_03_file               = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg
|vo_02_03_tx                 = My favorite food? It's the Guokui Flatbread! We'd always have it at our sect, and when I was little, I got extra servings like other younger disciples. Master Shiling even said that I'd followed his scent of freshly made flatbread all the way up the mountain, and that's how I joined our sect. I'm not sure if it was true or not though, he loves to rib us like that sometimes.

|vo_02_04_title              = Disliked Food
|vo_02_04_file               = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg
|vo_02_04_tx                 = There isn't any particular food that I dislike. I'm not much of a food person, I guess. People mix various ingredients for a variety of purposes—to gain muscle, to treat illnesses, or to stay healthy. The flavors of these food combinations are just natural outcomes. All types of food serve a purpose and can be beneficial.

|vo_02_05_title              = Ideals
|vo_02_05_file               = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg
|vo_02_05_tx                 = Unite the strengths that are both seen and unseen, and purge oneself of all that is unclean. Only then may one know the Tao's grandness; it is the final test every true Taoist must take.


<!-- Chat -->
|vo_03_01_title              = Chat: I
|vo_03_01_file               = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg
|vo_03_01_tx                 = I got the Mirrors of Clarity from Master Shiling when I was little. The mirrors represented my masters' good wishes for me: to stay dedicated, disciplined, and become a well-rounded individual. Each day, I carry them with me to honor their teachings, but more importantly, to remind myself of how much they cared for me.

|vo_03_02_title              = Chat: II
|vo_03_02_file               = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg
|vo_03_02_tx                 = To reach where our sect is, one must take the Ancient Path—it's the only way up the mountain. This is usually difficult for new disciples, but Master Shiling said when he took me in, I almost made it up the mountain as fast as he did. He said I was like a little wild animal: agile, vibrant, and naive. I can't remember any of that, though. The earliest memory I have is practicing martial arts with fellow disciples.


<!-- About Others -->
|vo_04_01_title              = About [[Chixia]]
|vo_04_01_intimacy           = 1
|vo_04_01_file               = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg
|vo_04_01_tx                 = Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.
|vo_04_01_mention            = Chixia

|vo_04_02_title              = About [[Yuanwu]]
|vo_04_02_intimacy           = 2
|vo_04_02_file               = {character}{language} About Yuanwu.ogg
|vo_04_02_tx                 = Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.
|vo_04_02_mention            = Yuanwu


<!-- Birthday -->
|vo_05_01_title              = Birthday Wishes
|vo_05_01_file               = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg
|vo_05_01_tx                 = I've only celebrated birthdays for my masters and fellow disciples before, and we'd usually make peach buns of longevity for the birthday person. So... here, I've made some peach buns for you! Happy Birthday! I wish you good health and great happiness!


<!-- Idles -->
|vo_06_01_title              = Idle: I
|vo_06_01_file               = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg
|vo_06_01_tx                 = Oh?

|vo_06_02_title              = Idle: II
|vo_06_02_file               = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg
|vo_06_02_tx                 = Self-awareness leads to wisdom... hmm?

|vo_06_03_title              = Idle: III
|vo_06_03_file               = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg
|vo_06_03_tx                 = What am I supposed to do with this... Hmm... W-whoah! Phew...


<!-- Greetings -->
|vo_07_01_title              = Self-Introduction
|vo_07_01_file               = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg
|vo_07_01_tx                 = I am Jianxin, the successor of {{Extra Effect|Fengyiquan|Fengyiquan|A martial art embodying Taoist wisdom, where practitioners harmonize with nature's rhythms to develop balanced strength of body and mind.}}. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?

|vo_07_02_title              = Greeting
|vo_07_02_file               = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg
|vo_07_02_tx                 = Release the wants, and the mind quiets. Cleanse the thoughts, and the soul clears.


<!-- Join Team -->
|vo_08_01_title              = Join Team: I
|vo_08_01_file               = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg
|vo_08_01_tx                 = Enemies ahead? I'm ready.

|vo_08_02_title              = Join Team: II
|vo_08_02_file               = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg
|vo_08_02_tx                 = What will I learn from this fight?

|vo_08_03_title              = Join Team: III
|vo_08_03_file               = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg
|vo_08_03_tx                 = I'll do my best!


<!-- Ascension -->
|vo_09_01_title              = Ascension: I
|vo_09_01_ascension          = 1
|vo_09_01_file               = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg
|vo_09_01_tx                 = This is a different practice, but it feels similar to how I usually do seated cultivation as my master taught. Hmm... how do I put this? I'll tell you once I've come up with a better way to describe.

|vo_09_02_title              = Ascension: II
|vo_09_02_ascension          = 2
|vo_09_02_file               = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg
|vo_09_02_tx                 = Finally, I've fully mastered this move. It all went so well today. Thank you for sparring with me!

|vo_09_03_title              = Ascension: III
|vo_09_03_ascension          = 3
|vo_09_03_file               = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg
|vo_09_03_tx                 = This is... the feeling of standing on top of a mountain, watching the billowing sea of clouds beneath my feet. The spirit within me resonates with every life in this universe... Yes, that's it! That's how it feels! I've finally figured out how to put this feeling into words!

|vo_09_04_title              = Ascension: IV
|vo_09_04_ascension          = 4
|vo_09_04_file               = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg
|vo_09_04_tx                 = Now my body and mind have gained a newfound clarity, and even my senses are keener than before. The Chi that surrounds me seems more... Oh no! Sorry! Are you alright? Phew... I should have paid more attention to keep it in check. I'll focus on improving my control of this power from now on. Thank you, Rover! I'm now another step closer to my goal!

|vo_09_05_title              = Ascension: V
|vo_09_05_ascension          = 5
|vo_09_05_file               = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg
|vo_09_05_tx                 = Is this real? I can't believe... Thank you, for everything you've done for me. No one, apart from my masters, has shown me more kindness in this life than you have. I can never repay in full what I owe to you, but I want to try anyway. There is something I've wanted to tell you for a while now: beyond seeking martial excellence, I've found another goal in life—to do everything I can for you, until my very last breath.
}}
